title: Swatch
description: A 12px square drawn as the mark a legend label stands for: the fill and an optional stroke arrive as CSS colour expressions, so a legend and its chart cannot disagree.

anatomy.description: An inline SVG with data-slot="swatch", aria-hidden; a single rect whose fill and stroke read the --fill and --stroke custom properties the component sets inline.

usage: Pass fill as a var(--juni-…) expression, the same one the series' CSS uses (var(--juni-categorical-0)), never a literal.
The swatch is decorative; the label beside it carries the meaning.
The stroke defaults to bark-600 at half alpha so a pale fill still has an edge.
